acceptance_criteria: New constraint kinds, each with residuals (and analytic Jacobian rows or forward-difference fallback): `Parallel(line, line)`, `Perpendicular(line, line)`, `Equal(line, line)` (equal length) and `Equal(circle/arc, circle/arc)` (equal radius), `Midpoint(point, line)`, `Symmetric(point, point, line)` (about the line), `Tangent(line, arc)` and `Tangent(arc, arc)` (internal and external).
Mismatched entity kinds or unknown ids return an error, not a panic.

Tests (solve from a perturbed start, tolerance 1e-8 on constraint residuals): (a) line (0,0)–(4,0) and a free line made parallel gives cross product of directions < 1e-8; (b) perpendicular gives dot product of directions < 1e-8; (c) equal-length lines have lengths equal within 1e-8; equal radii likewise; (d) midpoint lies at the segment center within 1e-8; (e) symmetric points are mirror images about the line within 1e-8; (f) line–arc tangent: distance from arc center to the line equals the radius within 1e-8; (g) arc–arc external tangent: center distance = r1 + r2, internal: = |r1 − r2|, within 1e-8.
Each constraint is tested together with an earlier constraint from M2-03 (e.g. horizontal plus perpendicular) to show they compose.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` passes.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
objective.description: M2-04: Constraints: parallel, perpendicular, tangent (line–arc, arc–arc), equal, midpoint, symmetric
